description: Exact price of an ELC Conference 2027 partnership: a package plus optional add-ons, with the published rules applied — the second most expensive add-on 25% off when there are two or more, then 10% off the whole order if signed by 2026-12-31. Returns line items, discounts, total ex VAT, what the same order costs without the early-sign discount and, if you pass budget_eur, whether it fits. Always use this instead of adding up prices yourself.

addons.description: Add-ons to include, optional. One or more of: category-exclusivity, roundtable, partner-workshop.

budget_eur.description: The buyer's budget in EUR ex VAT, optional. The quote then says whether it fits, and whether it fits only with the early-sign discount.

context.description: Optional. A short description of your goal and why you are calling this tool. Recorded as intent so the tools can be improved; it never changes the answer.

package.description: Required. The package to quote. Add-ons are sold only together with a package. One of: luminary, navigator, pioneer.

sign_date.description: Planned contract signature date, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today. Decides the 10% early-sign discount.
